title: PICC web measurement tool
description: A web application for collecting expert endpoint measurements, with per-item timing, on chest radiographs. It provides the reader arm of an AI-versus-radiologist comparison for PICC insertion-length prediction.

creators.name: Park, Sung-Joon
creators.affiliation: Department of Radiology, Korea University College of Medicine, Korea University Ansan Hospital, Ansan, South Korea
